name: screen
description: Screen manager with VT100/ANSI terminal emulation

options.description: Force all capabilities into each window's termcap
Adapt all windows to the new display width & height
Read configuration file instead of '.screenrc'
Change command characters
Flow control on
Flow control off
Flow control automatic
Set the size of the scrollback history buffer
Interrupt output sooner when flow control is on
Do nothing, just list our SockDir
Turn on output logging
Ignore $STY variable, do create a new screen session
Choose optimal output rather than exact vt100 emulation
Preselect the named window if it exists
Quiet startup. Exits with non-zero return code if unsuccessful
Shell to execute rather than $SHELL
Name this session <pid>.sockname instead of <pid>.<tty>.<host>
Set title. (window's name)
Use term as $TERM for windows, rather than 'screen'
Tell screen to use UTF-8 encoding
Print 'Screen version 4.00.03 (FAU) 23-Oct-06'
Do nothing, just clean up SockDir
Attach to a not detached screen. (Multi display mode)
Execute <cmd> as a screen command in the specified session

subcommands.name: -d
subcommands.description: Does not start screen, but detaches the elsewhere running screen session

subcommands.name: -r
subcommands.description: Reattach a session and if necessary detach it first

subcommands.name: -R
subcommands.description: Reattach a session and if necessary detach or even create it first

subcommands.name: -RR
subcommands.description: Reattach a session and if necessary detach or create it. Use the first session if more than one session is available

subcommands.name: -D
subcommands.description: Does not start screen, but detaches the elsewhere running screen session

subcommands.name: -r
subcommands.description: Reattach a session. If necessary detach and logout remotely first

subcommands.name: -R
subcommands.description: Attach here and now. In detail this means: If a session is running, then reattach. If necessary detach and logout remotely first

subcommands.name: -RR
subcommands.description: Attach here and now. Whatever that means, just do it

subcommands.name: -R
subcommands.description: Attempts to resume the first detached screen session it finds

subcommands.name: -dmS
subcommands.description: Start as daemon: Screen session in detached mode
